description: See how much of each provider's capacity is in use and when it frees up, right in the sidebar footer. Each provider gets its logo and one percentage, with accounts weighed by their plans, so a Claude Max 20x seat counts twenty times a Pro seat. Clicking a number opens a card with the account count and when the total drops next. When Account Pooler's Claude or Codex accounts hold resets, the card offers the one that frees the most capacity and spends it only after you confirm. Covers Account Pooler's accounts and any provider that reports usage to BB, such as Cursor; Account Pooler is optional.
